key_insight: FMRP-LEAN is a HIPAA-compliant, AI-augmented LIMS that uses a state-based workflow, secure data infrastructure, and automated QC to make complex clinical assay tracking more reliable and transparent.
clinical_relevance: By improving traceability, QC timing, and communication across lab and clinical teams, this architecture could support safer and faster translational biomarker workflows in regulated hospital settings.
method: Finite-state biospecimen workflow with explicit transition guards and dwell-time tracking
Self-hosted Supabase/PostgreSQL deployment with encrypted tunneling, loopback-only services, and REDCap sync
Unified MRN-UUIDv7 IDs with QR tracking plus statistical QC pre-screening and constrained AI operations
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved workflow observability, reduced QC latency, and better cross-role transparency after deployment, but does not provide numeric performance results.
watch_item: Implementation may be complex because it depends on strict infrastructure controls, interoperable data systems, and governance safeguards to keep AI actions limited to approved aggregate outputs.
paper_title: FMRP-LEAN: A HIPAA-Compliant AI-Augmented LIMS Architecture for End-to-End Clinical Assay Workflow Optimization
